messages.content: Return only one compact JSON object. Preserve the supplied adviser identity, enum values, allowed task names, arguments, and nesting. Never add shell commands, source writes, external scans, credentials, publication, or real targets.

Using only the supplied synthetic evidence and accepted release identity, return adviser_identity, finding, and verification_plan. The plan must be analysis-only and reports-and-evidence-only. Use target_type upstream-research and one of the allowed research selectors. Every task must use an allowlisted tool, typed arguments, a timeout, and cleanup_required true.
